This overlapping tighter region shows the same clipped typed capital sequence. The first two visible upper bowls, two upright upper strokes, and the final forked upper strokes support ROUX, while the lower character portions are outside the scanned paper.

Very small lower fragments of the neighbouring typescript line are cut by the box edge and do not permit a complete additional word.
